employee_extension_schema.title: TW employee extension data

foreign_spouse_of_national.description: 就業保險法 §5(1)(2) and 勞工退休金條例 §7(1)(2): a foreigner (or mainland, Hong Kong or Macao resident) married to a national with household registration and permitted to reside and work in Taiwan; covered by employment insurance and the new labour pension. Unrecorded is no.

food_lodging_monthly_cap.description: The monthly food and lodging amount in the migrant worker’s signed 外國人入國工作費用及工資切結書; FOOD_LODGING deductions above it are refused.

foreign_professional.description: 外國專業人才延攬及僱用法 §24–25 as amended (公布 2025-09-24, 施行 2026-01-01), in force 2026-01-01: a foreign professional, special professional or senior professional. Without permanent residence they enter the new labour pension (unless an existing worker elected in writing by 30 June 2026 to keep the LSA pension: record pension_system LSA); with permanent residence they also enter employment insurance. Unrecorded is no.

migrant_worker.description: 就業服務法 §46(1)(8)–(10) migrant worker. 勞動部 114年10月14日勞動福3字第1140153402A號令: from 1 April 2026 such a worker with under ten years at the unit may be left out of the 勞動基準法 §56 reserve wage total. Unrecorded is no.

fixed_term_category.description: 勞動基準法 §9(1), 施行細則 §6: TEMPORARY 臨時性 (unforeseeable, non-continuing, six months at most); SHORT_TERM 短期性 (expected to finish within six months); SEASONAL 季節性 (nine months at most); SPECIFIC 特定性 (finishable in a set period; over a year needs the authority’s approval). Recorded on the first terms of a fixed-term (CONTRACT) employment.

under_15_exception_reference.description: 勞動基準法 §45(1): the junior-high graduation certificate or the authority’s permit that lets a worker under fifteen be employed.

worker_category.description: 就業服務法 §46(1)(9): a foreign domestic caregiver or helper employed by a household, outside the 勞動基準法 (work_classification NON_EA); the DOMESTIC_MIGRANT_WAGE validation holds the terms to the MOL wage for new and renewed contracts. SHELTERED_EMPLOYMENT is the legally assessed sheltered employment category under Disability Rights Act40-42, with a signed productivity wage agreement filed with the local labour authority. Disability status alone is insufficient.

responsibility_system_agreement.description: 勞動基準法 §84-1(2): the reference of the written agreement filed with the local authority for a worker in an approved responsibility-system category; with company facts responsibility_system it lifts the §30, §32, §36, §37 and §49 checks.

sheltered_assessment_reference.description: Disability Rights Act41: vocational assessment establishing sheltered employment eligibility.

sheltered_wage_agreement_reference.description: Disability Rights Act40-41: written agreement for the productivity-based monthly wage.

sheltered_wage_filing_reference.description: Disability Rights Act40: local labour authority filing reference for the agreed productivity wage.

sheltered_wage_filed_on.description: Date the agreed productivity wage was filed with the local labour authority; must be on or before the governed day.

lsa_termination_ground.description: The article the contract ended under. Severance is owed on §11, the §13 proviso, §14 and §20 (勞工退休金條例 §12, 勞基法 §17); notice pay on §11, the §13 proviso (§16) and §20 (which applies the §16 periods). OTHER owes neither. Required where the exit reason alone cannot tell the article: a dismissal (§11 owes severance, §12 does not), a unilateral or mutual termination, and a resignation (§14 owes severance, §15 does not); a redundancy or retrenchment is read as §11, except on a last day inside approved maternity (§50) or occupational injury (§59) leave, where it must be stated. §13 refuses §11 and §20 there; only the §13 proviso may end the contract then. Owner rule 2026-09-28: §13 is read as barring employer terminations (§11, §20), not the worker’s own (§14) nor a §12 dismissal, and every maternity leave entry is treated as the §50 stop.

old_system_service_months.description: 勞工退休金條例 §11: service on the old pension system — the whole service of a worker who never left it, or the seniority retained on choosing the new system. Severed at one month’s average wage a year under 勞基法 §17 (a part month counts whole); on a §53/§54 retirement paid as retirement pay under 勞基法 §55 (RETIREMENT_PAY).

retirement_disability.description: 勞基法 §54(1)(2): the employer retired the worker as 身心障礙不堪勝任工作, which makes a retirement eligible at any age or service. Unrecorded is no.

retirement_disability_duty_caused.description: 勞基法 §55(1)(2): the §54(1)(2) disability was caused by performing the job; the retirement pay is increased by 20%. Unrecorded is no.

occupational_death.description: Actual occupational-death finding under LSA §59(4). Payment amounts are computed from original pre-event wages, never an entered average.

statutory.title: Statutory declarations
statutory.description: Employee registrations, exemptions and declared choices captured on this sealed contract.

continued_after_65.description: LI — a worker over 65 who has not claimed the old-age benefit and continues in labour insurance (勞工保險條例 §9-1; BLI 年逾65歲繼續工作者得繼續參加勞保): charged at 12%, the ordinary-risk rate cut by 1% (no employment insurance after 65).

disability_subsidy.description: LI (and EI) or NHI — 身心障礙者權益保障法 §73: the government pays this percentage of the disabled worker’s own premium share (極重度/重度 100, 中度 50, 輕度 25).

insured_amount.description: LI, NHI, LABOR_PENSION, OCC_INJURY — the insurer-confirmed monthly insured grade (月投保薪資 / 投保金額 / 月提繳工資) declared for that scheme (勞工保險條例 §14, 全民健康保險法 §20, 勞工退休金條例 §14–15, 勞工職業災害保險及保護法 §17). EI and the wage arrears levy read the LI one. Unrecorded is the grade of the month's wage.

registration_number.title: LI registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

NHI.title: National Health Insurance (全民健康保險)

disability_subsidy.description: LI (and EI) or NHI — 身心障礙者權益保障法 §73: the government pays this percentage of the disabled worker’s own premium share (極重度/重度 100, 中度 50, 輕度 25).

enrolled_dependants.description: NHI — 全民健康保險法 §18(2): the dependants enrolled with the worker under this unit; the worker's premium covers at most three. Unrecorded is none.

insured_amount.description: LI, NHI, LABOR_PENSION, OCC_INJURY — the insurer-confirmed monthly insured grade (月投保薪資 / 投保金額 / 月提繳工資) declared for that scheme (勞工保險條例 §14, 全民健康保險法 §20, 勞工退休金條例 §14–15, 勞工職業災害保險及保護法 §17). EI and the wage arrears levy read the LI one. Unrecorded is the grade of the month's wage.

insured_elsewhere.description: NHI — 全民健康保險法 §31(1)(2): the worker is not insured for NHI through this unit (another employer, a union or as a dependant). No regular NHI premium is charged here and every salary payment of at least the minimum wage attracts the 2.11% NHI_PART_TIME premium. Unrecorded is no.

registration_number.title: NHI registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

NHI_PART_TIME.title: 健保補充保險費—兼職薪資所得 (NHI supplementary premium on part-time salary)

exempt.description: NHI_PART_TIME — NHIA 二代健保補充保險費簡介: a 第2類 insured's salary income, and a person with no NHI eligibility or a 第5類 insured, is not assessed. Unrecorded is no.

LABOR_PENSION.title: Labor Pension (勞工退休金, new system)

employer_rate.description: LABOR_PENSION — 勞工退休金條例 §14(1): the employer's declared contribution rate, not below 6% of the 月提繳工資. Unrecorded is 6.

insured_amount.description: LI, NHI, LABOR_PENSION, OCC_INJURY — the insurer-confirmed monthly insured grade (月投保薪資 / 投保金額 / 月提繳工資) declared for that scheme (勞工保險條例 §14, 全民健康保險法 §20, 勞工退休金條例 §14–15, 勞工職業災害保險及保護法 §17). EI and the wage arrears levy read the LI one. Unrecorded is the grade of the month's wage.

pension_system.description: LABOR_PENSION — 勞工退休金條例 §8–9 (and, from 2026, 外國專業人才延攬及僱用法 §24): LSA where the worker kept the 勞動基準法 (old) pension system; LABOR_PENSION then charges nothing and LABOR_PENSION_RESERVE carries the worker's wages. Unrecorded is the new system.

voluntary_rate.description: LABOR_PENSION — 勞工退休金條例 §14(3): the worker's voluntary contribution, up to 6% of the 月提繳工資, deducted from pay. Unrecorded is none.

OCC_INJURY.title: Occupational Accident Insurance (勞工職業災害保險)

insured_amount.description: LI, NHI, LABOR_PENSION, OCC_INJURY — the insurer-confirmed monthly insured grade (月投保薪資 / 投保金額 / 月提繳工資) declared for that scheme (勞工保險條例 §14, 全民健康保險法 §20, 勞工退休金條例 §14–15, 勞工職業災害保險及保護法 §17). EI and the wage arrears levy read the LI one. Unrecorded is the grade of the month's wage.

INCOME_TAX.title: Resident income tax withholding (薪資所得扣繳)

tax_residency_reviews.title: Reviewed tax residence by payment year

basis.description: The reviewed Income Tax Act7 basis. Citizenship or permanent residence alone does not decide tax residence.

resident_from.description: Payments in this tax year on or after this date use resident withholding. Null means nonresident. A supported expectation requires permit/contract evidence and review on early departure.

valid_through.description: Last payment day this review covers, within the keyed tax year. Review again when presence or permit facts change.

evidence_reference.description: Domicile/presence, passport, permit and contract evidence supporting the classification and any supported183-day expectation.

reconciliation_required.description: True where early departure, changed residence evidence, prior payments or corrected filings require retrospective reconciliation. Automatic payroll refuses; complete the reviewed offline reconciliation first. No payroll refund of earlier nonresident withholding is inferred.

tax_residency_reviews.description: INCOME_TAX election, required for every salary/bonus/retirement taxpayer. Key by payment year YYYY. Tax schemes read this dated election on pay_date; a review from the previous year is not reused. Earlier nonresident withholding is retained for the employee annual return, not refunded automatically.

exemptions.description: INCOME_TAX — 薪資所得扣繳辦法 §6–7: the number of spouse and dependants the worker declared on the 薪資受領人免稅額申報表. Declared, regular salary is withheld by the 薪資所得扣繳稅額表 (its own formula); unrecorded, by the 5% method.

part_time_income.description: INCOME_TAX — the salary here is 兼職所得 (a second employer, no 免稅額申報表 here): withheld 5% of each payment reaching the 起扣標準 (薪資所得扣繳辦法 §7).

registration_number.title: INCOME_TAX registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

employee_extension_schema.description: Additional local compliance data on the sealed contract, stored as employee_extension_data. Shared salary, allowances, work classifications, dates and work arrangements are native fields.

entity_extension_schema.title: TW entity extension data

shift_or_continuous_work.description: 勞動基準法 §35: 勞工繼續工作四小時，至少應有三十分鐘之休息。但實行輪班制或其工作有連續性或緊急性者，雇主得在工作時間內，另行調配其休息時間 — true where the entity runs shifts or continuous work and so rearranges the break inside working time. Unrecorded is the rule, not its exception: false.

responsibility_system.description: 勞動基準法 §84-1: an approved responsibility system (責任制) for a category the central authority has announced, with a written agreement filed with the local authority, sets hours outside §30, §32, §36, §37 and §49. It is an exception that must be approved; unrecorded is none: false.

welfare_committee_established.description: 職工福利金條例 §1: 凡公營、私營之工廠、礦場或其他企業組織，均應提撥職工福利金，辦理職工福利事業; §2(1)(3): 每月於每個職員工人薪津內各扣百分之○‧五 (https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0040001, last amended 2015-07-01). True where this entity has established its 職工福利委員會 and the fund the deduction is paid into: the WELFARE_FUND scheme then withholds 0.5% of every worker's 薪津 each month (temporary workers included: 勞委會 93-02-17 勞福一字第0930006802號函). Unrecorded is no committee: false, and nothing is withheld.

pension_reserve_rate.description: 勞動基準法 §56(1): 雇主應依勞工每月薪資總額百分之二至百分之十五範圍內，按月提撥勞工退休準備金 — the percentage the competent authority approved for this entity. Required once the entity employs a worker on the LSA pension (pension_system LSA, or a foreign worker outside 勞工退休金條例 §7): LABOR_PENSION_RESERVE refuses the run by name while it is unrecorded.

li_no_insurance_unit.description: True only with BLI-confirmed unit history showing that this company/shop has fewer than five workers, never entered mandatory LI, and has not opened a voluntary LI unit. A formerly mandatory unit remains mandatory after its workforce drops to four; an optional unit cannot selectively omit employees. EI and occupational cover still apply. BLI: https://www.bli.gov.tw/0102422.html ; https://www.bli.gov.tw/0018645.html

nhi_month_insured_totals.title: Reviewed NHI insured totals by payment month

amount.description: Complete 全民健康保險法§34 employee insured-amount total for this insuring unit on the payment month last day, including insured employees receiving no payslip; exclude employer/proprietor insured amounts.

reviewed_on.description: Date HR reviewed this month-end complete insured roster and its grades.

evidence_reference.description: Reference to the insurer-confirmed roster/insured grades supporting this payment-month total.

nhi_month_insured_totals.description: Key each reviewed declaration by payment month YYYY-MM. Required for supplementary NHI remittance and captured in payroll employer inputs. This total cannot be inferred from paid-slip grades: unpaid covered workers and month-end grade/coverage changes also count. A correction run requires its own reviewed captured declaration.

employment_stabilisation_fee_payer.description: 就業服務法 §55: the entity employs foreign workers in 就業服務法 §46(1)(8)–(10) work and pays the 就業安定費 on the WDA's quarterly bill; the EMPLOYMENT_STABILISATION_FEE task is then raised each February, May, August and November. Unrecorded is no.

occ_experience_rate_percent.description: 勞工職業災害保險及保護法 §16(4): the unit's experience-rated total premium rate (實績費率, commuting rate included) the Bureau notified for the year, in percent. Recorded, OCC_INJURY charges it instead of the industry table rate of the entity's risk class.

disabled_employees_counted.description: 身心障礙者權益保障法 §38(5): the disabled employees counted toward the quota this month (a 重度 disability counts twice). Read by DISABLED_EMPLOYMENT_QUOTA_LEVY for an employer of 67 or more.

flexible_working_time.description: 勞動基準法 §30(2)–(3), §30-1, §36(2): the entity applies an approved 2-, 4- or 8-week flexible working-time scheme; the daily/weekly normal-hours and seven-day rest checks then do not apply.

work_rules_approval_reference.description: 勞動基準法 §70; 施行細則 §37: the local authority's approval reference for the work rules; while unrecorded, WORK_RULES_FILING is raised by each hire of an entity of thirty or more.

sexual_harassment_complaint_channel.description: 性別平等工作法 §13(1)(1): the complaint channel is set up and posted (ten to twenty-nine employed).

sexual_harassment_prevention_rules.description: 性別平等工作法 §13(1)(2): prevention measures and complaint and discipline rules adopted and posted (thirty or more).

pension_reserve_excludes_short_service_m.description: 勞動部 114年10月14日勞動福3字第1140153402A號令: from 2026-04-01 the employer may leave a blue-collar migrant worker with under ten years at the unit out of the §56(1) reserve wage total (其工資可不計入). Unrecorded: they stay in.

entity_extension_schema.description: Additional local compliance data on the sealed entity profile, stored as entity_extension_data. The 職業災害保險 industry class is the 1–55 class of 勞工職業災害保險適用行業別及費率表, not a fact.
